title: Page 340
transc:
H. F. Lines Macon Ga  Washn May 16th 1865 
Growl Fanny Gas for Shelby Wilson zebra The rambling dispatch
just been sent Lady You can make preparations accordingly Rawlins


To JC Sullivan Nashville (also)
Fanny Gift Lamb unity Direct Shelter Wilson to leave saint 
of pension purple office pontiac to garrison such places as
he now holds and deems tartar tobey garrisoned with instructions
to draw their supplies pedlar such as they can not
get sligo Country pekin peasant Belgrade & Ocmulges windsors and
to tanner withey remainder office pontiac to such vernon as
you may designate on the Bethel and by such route
as you may deem most practicable zodiac He should commence
his talbot optic earliest practicable moment ditto In designating Salem
tobey stomach in Argus no whip whose term service expires
honor prior to plug day of October next should be
stomach By polka Jupiter youth Jno A Rawlins Palate &
chief Staff copy sent (Lines Dismal) unity use unity use Knell &
(Sullivan Embrace)
Knight for Shelby Wilson please insert same in your plugs 


John Horner NY  Washn May 16th 
Hon Edwards Pierf veron France Shelby Fry whites 
that not more than pledge persons are in
saco Lafayette for bounty jumping the rest being
poplars and prisoners of war zebra More than
a week ago all were ordered tobey numbered
and released except poplars and prisoners of war
This I suppose has been oris being done 
EM Stanton
